schedulingRules.Job input: One complete part and total positive whole-number quantity per row
schedulingRules.Route: All exact orange-approved operations, sorted by effective operation sequence
schedulingRules.Dependency: When both are entered, every child unit and generated sub-batch must finish before the parent's first operation begins
schedulingRules.Concurrency: Different work centers can run simultaneously with different qualified employees
schedulingRules.Work center: One sub-batch operation at a time per exact work center
schedulingRules.Operator: One sub-batch operation at a time; present and skill level at least the threshold
schedulingRules.Batch: Each whole unit may advance after its own preceding route operation finishes; it does not wait for the remaining quantity
schedulingRules.Cutoff: Each sub-batch operation must fit inside one contiguous employee availability window
schedulingRules.Dispatch: Active children before parents; then priority, due time, shorter route time, stable job order, unit, and route step
